subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI permit remote `http`/`https` Markdown image URLs from chat content to load inline, and if yes should that be direct browser fetch, same-origin proxy, or explicit opt-in?
rationale: Current code, tests, docs, and merged hardening intentionally prevent remote browser image fetches, while the requested UX changes that security boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve the current default and require same-origin media, local blob/data images, or an explicitly approved proxy/opt-in design before remote image rendering.

options.title: Approve a proxy or opt-in path
options.body: Allow inline remote images only through a designed operator-controlled mechanism with coordinated renderer, CSP, docs, tests, and real browser proof.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Accept the privacy and tracking tradeoff and update the renderer, sanitizer/CSP, docs, tests, and browser proof together.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current default and require same-origin media, local blob/data images, or an explicitly approved proxy/opt-in design before remote image rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily the Control UI browser-fetch and CSP security policy that drobison00 most directly touched in merged history.
